# pai zettel

Explore the links between your notes

```
pai zettel <command>
```

Works on a vault of linked notes: follow link chains, find surprising connections, ask questions, spot themes, check structural health. Commands that need to know which vault take --vault-project-id.

```sh
pai zettel health
pai zettel explore my-note --depth 2
pai zettel themes --vault-project-id 3
```

See also: `pai obsidian`, `pai memory search`

### pai zettel explore

Follow link chains from a note

```
pai zettel explore NOTE [options]
```

Starting at a note, walks the links outward and prints what it reaches.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NOTE` | yes | Note path or title |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--depth N` | number | 3 | How far to follow links (1-10) |
| `--direction DIR` | string | both | forward, backward or both |
| `--mode MODE` | string | all | sequential, associative or all |

```sh
pai zettel explore my-note
pai zettel explore my-note --depth 2 --direction forward
```

See also: `pai zettel suggest`

### pai zettel surprise

Find notes that are alike in meaning but far apart in links

```
pai zettel surprise NOTE [options]
```

Surprising connections: pairs of notes that say similar things yet are not linked near each other.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NOTE` | yes | Note path or title |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault-project-id N` | string | — | Required. Id of the vault's project (see `pai project list`) |
| `--limit N` | number | 10 | Maximum results |
| `--min-similarity F` | number | 0.3 | Least similarity to accept (0-1) |
| `--min-distance N` | number | 3 | Least link distance to accept |

```sh
pai zettel surprise my-note --vault-project-id 3
pai zettel surprise my-note --vault-project-id 3 --limit 5
```

See also: `pai zettel suggest`

### pai zettel converse

Ask the vault a question

```
pai zettel converse QUESTION [options]
```

Finds the notes relevant to a question and prints a prompt that bundles them, ready to hand to a model.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QUESTION` | yes | What you want to know |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault-project-id N` | string | — | Required. Id of the vault's project (see `pai project list`) |
| `--depth N` | number | 2 | How far to expand around matching notes |
| `--limit N` | number | 15 | Maximum notes to include |

```sh
pai zettel converse "what did we decide about caching?" --vault-project-id 3
pai zettel converse "why did the build break" --vault-project-id 3 --depth 1
```

See also: `pai memory search`

### pai zettel themes

Spot topics emerging in recent notes

```
pai zettel themes [options]
```

Clusters recently edited notes by similarity and names the groups.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault-project-id N` | string | — | Required. Id of the vault's project (see `pai project list`) |
| `--days N` | number | 30 | Look back this many days |
| `--min-size N` | number | 3 | Fewest notes in a theme |
| `--max-themes N` | number | 10 | Most themes to show |
| `--threshold F` | number | 0.65 | How alike notes must be to group (0-1) |

```sh
pai zettel themes --vault-project-id 3
pai zettel themes --vault-project-id 3 --days 7
```

See also: `pai zettel health`

### pai zettel health

Check the vault for dead links and orphans

```
pai zettel health [options]
```

Structural audit: dead links, orphan notes, disconnected groups and weakly connected notes.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--scope SCOPE` | string | full | full, recent or project |
| `--project PATH` | string | — | Project path prefix (needs --scope project) |
| `--days N` | number | 30 | Look-back window (needs --scope recent) |
| `--include LIST` | string | — | Comma list of: dead_links, orphans, disconnected, low_connectivity |

```sh
pai zettel health
pai zettel health --scope recent --days 7
pai zettel health --include dead_links,orphans
```

See also: `pai zettel themes`

### pai zettel suggest

Suggest new links for a note

```
pai zettel suggest NOTE [options]
```

Proposes notes the given note should probably link to.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NOTE` | yes | Note path or title |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault-project-id N` | string | — | Required. Id of the vault's project (see `pai project list`) |
| `--limit N` | number | 5 | Maximum suggestions |
| `--no-exclude-linked` | flag | — | Also suggest notes that are already linked |

```sh
pai zettel suggest my-note --vault-project-id 3
pai zettel suggest my-note --vault-project-id 3 --limit 10
```

See also: `pai zettel explore`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai zettel explore` | Follow link chains from a note |
| `pai zettel surprise` | Find notes that are alike in meaning but far apart in links |
| `pai zettel converse` | Ask the vault a question |
| `pai zettel themes` | Spot topics emerging in recent notes |
| `pai zettel health` | Check the vault for dead links and orphans |
| `pai zettel suggest` | Suggest new links for a note |

## Examples

```bash
# Explore the neighbourhood of a note
pai zettel explore "token factory"

# Surface an unexpected connection
pai zettel surprise

# Emergent themes across the vault
pai zettel themes

# Vault connectivity health (orphans, dead links)
pai zettel health
```
